G0435.def:
**ἀνήρ**, ἀνδρός, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;]
**a man**, Lat. vir.
1. As opposite to a woman, [[Act.8.12|Act.8:12]], [[1Ti.2.12|1Ti.2:12]]; as a **husband**, [[Mat.1.16|Mat.1:16]], [[Jhn.4.16|Jhn.4:16]], [[Rom.7.2|Rom.7:2]], [[Tit.1.6|Tit.1:6]].
2. As opposite to a boy or infant, [[1Co.13.11|1Co.13:11]], [[Eph.4.13|Eph.4:13]], [[Jas.3.2|Jas.3:2]].
3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, [[Luk.5.8|Luk.5:8]] ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, [[Act.1.16|Act.1:16]] and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, [[Act.22.3|Act.22:3]] ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35.
4. In general, **a man, a male person**: = τις, [[Luk.8.41|Luk.8:41]], [[Act.6.11|Act.6:11]].
_SYN._: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word). (AS)

G0455.def:
**ἀν-οίγω**
(ἀνά, οἴγω = οἴγνυμι) [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַח ;]
**to open**;
1. trans., with accusative; a door or gate, [[Act.5.19; 12.14|Act.5:19 12:14]], [[Rev.4.1|Rev.4:1]]; pass., [[Act.12.10; 16.26-27|Act.12:10 16:26-27]]; metaphorically of opportunity or welcome, [[Act.14.27|Act.14:27]], [[Col.4.3|Col.4:3]], [[Rev.3.20|Rev.3:20]]; pass., [[1Co.16.9|1Co.16:9]], [[2Co.2.12|2Co.2:12]], [[Rev.3.8|Rev.3:8]]; absol. (sc. θύραν), [[Act.5.23; 12.16|Act.5:23 12:16]]; with dative of person(s), [[Luk.12.36|Luk.12:36]], [[Jhn.10.3|Jhn.10:3]]; metaphorically, [[Mat.7.7-8; 25.11|Mat.7:7-8 25:11]], [[Luk.11.9-10; 13.25|Luk.11:9-10 13:25]], [[Rev.3.7|Rev.3:7]]; θησαυρούς ([[Sir.43.14|Sir.43:14]]), [[Mat.2.11|Mat.2:11]]; τ. μνημεῖα, [[Mat.27.52|Mat.27:52]] τάφος, [[Rom.3.13|Rom.3:13]] τ. φρέαρ, [[Rev.9.2|Rev.9:2]] of heaven, [[Mat.3.16|Mat.3:16]], [[Luk.3.21|Luk.3:21]], [[Act.10.11|Act.10:11]], [[Rev.11.19; 15.5; 19.11|Rev.11:19 15:5 19:11]]; σφραγῖδα, [[Rev.5.9; 6.1|Rev.5:9 6:1]] ff. [[Rev.8.1|Rev.8:1]]; βιβλίον, βιβλαρίδιον, [[Luk.4.17|Luk.4:17]], [[Rev.5.2-5; 10.2, 8; 20.12|Rev.5:2-5 10:2, 8 20:12]]; τ. στόμα, [[Mat.17.27|Mat.17:27]] id. Hebraistically ([[Num.22.28|Num.22:28]], [[Job.3.1|Job.3:1]], [[Isa.50.5|Isa.50:5]], al.), of beginning to speak, [[Mat.5.2|Mat.5:2]], [[Act.8.32, 35; 10.34; 18.14|Act.8:32, 35 10:34 18:14]]; before εἰς βλαιφημίας, [[Rev.13.6|Rev.13:6]] ἐν παραβολαῖς ([[Psa.78.2|Psa.78:2]]), [[Mat.13.35|Mat.13:35]]; of recovering speech, [[Luk.1.64|Luk.1:64]] of the earth opening, [[Rev.12.16|Rev.12:16]] τ. ὀφθαλμoύς, [[Act.9.8, 40|Act.9:8, 40]]; id. with genitive of person(s), of restoring sight, [[Mat.9.30; 20.33|Mat.9:30 20:33]], [[Jhn.9:1ff; 10.21, 11:37ff|Jhn.9:1ff; 10.21, 11:37]]ff ; metaphorically, [[Act.26.18|Act.26:18]] ἀκοάς, with genitive of person(s), of restoring hearing, [[Mrk.7.35|Mrk.7:35]]
2. Intrans. in 2 pf., ἀνέῳγα (M, _Pr._, 154); heaven, [[Jhn.1.51|Jhn.1:51]] τ. στόμα, before πρός, of speaking freely, [[2Co.6.11|2Co.6:11]] (cf. δι-ανοίγω and see MM, _VGT_, 45).†
(AS)

G0402.def:
**ἀνα-χωρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּרַח, נוּם, etc. ;]
1. to go back.
2. **to withdraw**: [[Mat.9.24|Mat.9:24]] frequently in sense of avoiding danger (MM, _VGT_, see word), [[Mat.2.12|Mat.2:12]] (but see Thayer), [[Mat.2.13-14, 22; 4.12; 12.15; 14.13; 15.21; 27.5|Mat.2:13-14, 22 4:12 12:15 14:13 15:21 27:5]], [[Mrk.3.7|Mrk.3:7]], [[Jhn.6.15|Jhn.6:15]], [[Act.23.19; 26.31|Act.23:19 26:31]].†
(AS)

G0473.def:
**ἀντί**
(the ι is elided only in ἀνθ᾽ ὧν), prep. with genitive (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word);
1. prop, in local sense, over against, opposite, hence
2. **instead of, in place of, for **(Hom., etc.): [[Mat.5.38; 17.27|Mat.5:38 17:27]], [[Luk.11.11|Luk.11:11]], [[1Co.11.15|1Co.11:15]], [[Heb.12.2|Heb.12:2]]; with artic. inf. (cl.), [[Jas.4.15|Jas.4:15]] of succession, [[Mat.2.22|Mat.2:22]] χάριν ἀ. χάριτος, [[Jhn.1.16|Jhn.1:16]] (M, _Pr._, 100); of price in exchange, [[Heb.12.16|Heb.12:16]] λύτρον ἀ. πολλῶν, [[Mat.20.28|Mat.20:28]], [[Mrk.10.45|Mrk.10:45]] (M, _Pr._, 105); of requital, [[Rom.12.17|Rom.12:17]], [[1Th.5.16|1Th.5:16]], [[1Pe.3.9|1Pe.3:9]] (cf. [[Wis.11.15|Wis.11:15]]); ἀνθ᾽ ὧν, because, [[Luk.1.20; 19.44|Luk.1:20 19:44]], [[Act.12.23|Act.12:23]], [[2Th.2.10|2Th.2:10]] (cl., LXX for אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת); id. therefore (cl., LXX), [[Luk.12.3|Luk.12:3]] ἀ. τούτου (LXX for כֵּן נַעֲרָה)[[Eph.5.31|Eph.5:31]] As a prefix, ἀντι- (before vowels ἀντ-, ἀνθ᾽-), denotes
(a) **over against**, ἀντιπέραν;
(b) **co-operation**, ἀντιβάλλειν;
(with) **requital**, ἀντιμισθία;
(d) **opposition**, ἀντίχριστος;
(e) **substitution**, ἀνθύπατος.
Compounds of ἀ. usually govern dative (B1., § 37, 7).†
(AS)

G0444.def:
**ἄνθρωπος**, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ ,אָדָם, also for אֱנוֹשׁ, etc. ;]
**man**:
1. **generically, a human being, male or female **(Lat. homo): [[Jhn.16.21|Jhn.16:21]] with art., [[Mat.4.4; 12.35|Mat.4:4 12:35]], [[Mrk.2.27|Mrk.2:27]], [[Jhn.2.25|Jhn.2:25]], [[Rom.7.1|Rom.7:1]], al; disting. from God, [[Mat.19.6|Mat.19:6]], [[Jhn.10.33|Jhn.10:33]], [[Col.3.23|Col.3:23]], al.; from animals, etc., [[Mat.4.19|Mat.4:19]], [[Luk.5.10|Luk.5:10]], [[Rev.9.4|Rev.9:4]], al.; implying human frailty and imperfection, [[1Co.3.4|1Co.3:4]] σοφία ἀνθρώπων, [[1Co.2.5|1Co.2:5]] ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαι, [[1Pe.4.2|1Pe.4:2]] κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖν, [[1Co.3.3|1Co.3:3]] κατὰ ἄ. λέγειν (λαλεῖν), [[Rom.3.5|Rom.3:5]], [[1Co.9.8|1Co.9:8]]; κατὰ ἄ- λέγειν, [[Gal.3.15|Gal.3:15]] (cf. [[1Co.15.32|1Co.15:32]], [[Gal.1.11|Gal.1:11]]); by meton., of man's nature or condition, ὁ ἔσω (ἔξω) ἄ., [[Rom.7.22|Rom.7:22]], [[Eph.3.16|Eph.3:16]], [[2Co.4.16|2Co.4:16]] (cf. [[1Pe.3.4|1Pe.3:4]]); ὁ παλαιὸς, καινὸς, νέος ἄ., [[Rom.6.6|Rom.6:6]], [[Eph.2.15; 4.22, 24|Eph.2:15 4:22, 24]] [[Col.3.9, 10|Col.3:9, 10]]; joined with another subst., ἄ. ἔμπορος, **a merchant**, [[Mat.13.45|Mat.13:45]] (WH, txt. om. ἄ.); οἰκοδεσπότης, [[Mat.13.52|Mat.13:52]] βασιλεύς, 18:23; φάγος, 11:19; with name of nation, Κυρηναῖος, [[Mat.27.32|Mat.27:32]] Ἰουδαῖος, [[Act.21.39|Act.21:39]] Ῥωμαῖος, [[Act.16.37|Act.16:37]] pl. οἱ ἄ., **men, people**: [[Mat.5.13, 16|Mat.5:13, 16]] [[Mrk.8.24|Mrk.8:24]], [[Jhn.4.28|Jhn.4:28]]; οὐδεὶς ἀνθρώπων, [[Mrk.11.2|Mrk.11:2]], [[1Ti.6.16|1Ti.6:16]].
2. Indef., ἄ. = τις, **some one, a man**: [[Mat.17.14|Mat.17:14]], [[Mrk.12.1|Mrk.12:1]], al.; τις ἄ., [[Mat.18.12|Mat.18:12]], [[Jhn.5.5|Jhn.5:5]], al.; indef. **one** (Fr. _on_), [[Rom.3.28|Rom.3:28]], [[Gal.2.16|Gal.2:16]], al.; opposite to women, servants, etc., [[Mat.10.36; 19.10|Mat.10:36 19:10]], [[Jhn.7.22|Jhn.7:22]], 23.
3. Definitely, with art., of some particular person; [[Mat.12.13|Mat.12:13]], [[Mrk.3.5|Mrk.3:5]], al.; οὗτος ὁ ἄ., [[Luk.14.30|Luk.14:30]] ὁ ἄ οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, [[Mrk.14.71|Mrk.14:71]], [[Mat.12.45|Mat.12:45]]; ὁ ἄ. τ. ἀνομίας, [[2Th.2.3|2Th.2:3]] ἄ τ. θεοῦ (of Heb. אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים), [[1Ti.6.11|1Ti.6:11]], [[2Ti.3.17|2Ti.3:17]], [[2Pe.1.21|2Pe.1:21]]; ὁ υἰὸς τοῦ ἀ., see: υἱός.
_SYN._: ἀνήρ, which see (and cf. MM, _VGT_, 44; Cremer, 103, 635). (AS)

G0476.def:
**ἀντίδικος**, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX for רִיב ;]
as subst., **an opponent in a lawsuit, adversary**: [[Mat.5.25|Mat.5:25]], [[Luk.12.58; 18.3|Luk.12:58 18:3]], [[1Pe.5.8|1Pe.5:8]] (Cremer, 696; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0436.def:
**ἀνθ-ίοτημι**
(ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for עָמַד, יָצַב, etc. ;]
1. in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against.
2. In mid, and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., **to withstand, resist, oppose**: with dative, [[Mat.5.39|Mat.5:39]], [[Luk.21.15|Luk.21:15]], [[Act.6.10; 13.8|Act.6:10 13:8]], [[Rom.9.19; 13.2|Rom.9:19 13:2]], [[Gal.2.11|Gal.2:11]], [[Eph.6.13|Eph.6:13]], [[2Ti.3.8; 4.15|2Ti.3:8 4:15]], [[Jas.4.7|Jas.4:7]], [[1Pe.5.9|1Pe.5:9]].†
(AS)

G0472.def:
**ἀντ-ὲχω**
(ἀντί, ἔχω), [in LXX for חָזַק hi., etc. ;]
1. trans., to hold against.
2. Intrans., to withstand. Mid. 1. in cl., to hold out against.
3. (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word), **to hold firmly to, cleave to**: with genitive (see Bl., § 36, 2), [[Mat.6.24|Mat.6:24]], [[Luk.16.13|Luk.16:13]], [[1Th.5.14|1Th.5:14]] (see M, _Th._, in l), [[Tit.1.9|Tit.1:9]]†
(AS)

G0458.def:
**ἀνομία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἄνομος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, פֶּשַׁע, תּוֹעֵבַה, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
**lawlessness, iniquity**: [[Mat.7.23; 13.41; 23.28; 24.12|Mat.7:23 13:41 23:28 24:12]], [[Rom.6.19|Rom.6:19]], [[2Co.6.14|2Co.6:14]], [[2Th.2.3; 2.7|2Th.2:3 2:7]], [[Tit.2.14|Tit.2:14]], [[Heb.1.9|Heb.1:9]], [[1Jn.3.4|1Jn.3:4]]; in pl. (as LXX, [[Psa.31.1|Psa.31:1]], al.; see 131., § 32, 6; Swete, _Mk._, 153), of acts or manifestations of lawlessness: [[Rom.4.7|Rom.4:7]] (LXX), [[Heb.10.17|Heb.10:17]]†
_SYN._: see: ἁμάρτημα, ἄνομος (AS)

G0450.def:
**ἀνίστημι** (ἀνά, ἵστημι),
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1. causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., with accusative, **to raise up**: [[Act.9.41|Act.9:41]] from death, [[Jhn.6.39|Jhn.6:39]], [[Act.2.32|Act.2:32]]; **to raise up, cause to be born or appear**: [[Mat.22.24|Mat.22:24]], [[Act.3.22, 26|Act.3:22, 26]].
2. Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.;
(a) **to rise**: from lying, [[Mrk.1.35|Mrk.1:35]] from sitting, [[Luk.4.16|Luk.4:16]] to leave a place, [[Mat.9.9|Mat.9:9]] pleonastically, as Heb. קוּם, before verbs of going, [[Mrk.10.1|Mrk.10:1]], al. (see Dalman, _Words_, 23; M, _Pr._, 14); of the dead, [[Mat.17.23|Mat.17:23]], [[Mrk.8.31|Mrk.8:31]]; before ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[Mat.17.9|Mat.17:9]], [[Mrk.9.9|Mrk.9:9]];
(b) **to arise, appear**: [[Act.5.36|Act.5:36]], [[Rom.15.12|Rom.15:12]] (cf. ἐπ-, ἐξ- ἀνίστημι, and see Cremer, 306, 738; MM, _VGT_, see word).
SYN.: ἐγείρω.
(AS)

G0427.def:
**ἄνευ **
prep. with genitive (rarer than χωρίς, which see; cf. Ellic. on [[Eph.2.12|Eph.2:12]] MM, _VGT_, 42),
**without**: [[Mat.10.29|Mat.10:29]], [[1Pe.3.1; 4.9|1Pe.3:1 4:9]].†
(AS)

G0465.def:
**ἀντ-άλλαγμα**, -τος, τό
(ἀντί, ἄλλαγμα; ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מְחִיר ;]
**an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce**: [[Mat.16.26|Mat.16:26]], [[Mrk.8.37|Mrk.8:37]] (cf. [[Sir.26.14|Sir.26:14]] and see Swete, _Mk._, l.with; Cremer, 90).†
(AS)

G0430.def:
**ἀν-έχω **
[in LXX chiefly for אָפַק hithp. ;]
**to hold up**; in NT always mid., **to bear with, endure**: in cl. most frequently with accusative, but in NT with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.17.17|Mat.17:17]], [[Mrk.9.19|Mrk.9:19]], [[Luk.9.41|Luk.9:41]], [[2Co.11.1; 11.19|2Co.11:1 11:19]], [[Eph.4.2|Eph.4:2]], [[Col.3.13|Col.3:13]]; before μικρόν τι, with genitive of person(s) and with genitive of thing(s), [[2Co.11.1|2Co.11:1]] with dative of thing(s), [[2Th.1.4|2Th.1:4]] (v M, _Th._, in l); before εἴ τις, [[2Co.11.20|2Co.11:20]] absol., [[1Co.4.12|1Co.4:12]], [[2Co.11.4|2Co.11:4]]; to bear with = to listen to, with genitive of person(s), [[Act.18.14|Act.18:14]] with genitive of thing(s), [[2Ti.4.3|2Ti.4:3]], [[Heb.13.22|Heb.13:22]] (cf. προσανέχω and MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0432.def: **anise, dill **, (Aristophanes Comicus); ionic ἄννησον or ἄνησον (Herdotus Historicus); aeolic ἄννητον, or ἄνητον, (Sapho). (ML)

G0400.def:
**ἀνα-φωνέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַע hi., זָכַר hi. ;]
**to cry out, exclaim**: [[Luk.1.42|Luk.1:42]] (Arist., al.).†
(AS)

G0429.def:
**ἀν-ευρίσκω**
(ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), [in LXX: [[4Ma.3.14|4Ma.3:14]] * ;]
**to find out by search, discover **(see Field, _Notes_, 47 f.): [[Luk.2.16|Luk.2:16]], [[Act.21.4|Act.21:4]].†
(AS)

G0437.def:
**ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι**, -οῦμαι
(ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι) [in LXX: [[Psa.79.13|Psa.79:13]] (יָדָה), Dan LXX 4:34 (שְׁבַח), I [[Est.8.91|Est.8:91]], [[Sir.20.2|Sir.20:2]], [[3Ma.6.33|3Ma.6:33]] * ;]
1. to make a mutual agreement (Dem., Polyb.).
2. to acknowledge fully, confess (Diod., Polyb., cf. 1Esdras, l.with).
3. C. dative of person(s), **to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to **(cf. Ps, l.with): [[Luk.2.38|Luk.2:38]] (Cremer, 771; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0452.def:
**Ἄννας**, -α (FlJ, Ἄνανος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. חָנַן),
**Annas, the high priest**: [[Luk.3.2|Luk.3:2]], [[Jhn.18.13-24|Jhn.18:13-24]], [[Act.4.6|Act.4:6]].†
(AS)

G0454.def:
**ἀνοια**, -ας, ἡ
(ἄ-νοος, without understanding), [in LXX: [[Pro.14.8, 2215|Pro.14:8, 2215]] (אִוֶּלֶת), [[Wis.15.18|Wis.15:18]], al. ;]
**folly, foolishness**: [[2Ti.3.9|2Ti.3:9]] expressed in violent rage (cf. Plat., Tim., 86B): [[Luk.6.11|Luk.6:11]]†
(AS)

G0495.def:
**ἀντί-περα** (Rec. ἀντιπέραν, LTr. ἀντιπέρα) _adv._, = cl. ἀντιπέρας (MM, _VGT_, 49),
**on the opposite side**: with genitive, [[Luk.8.26|Luk.8:26]]†
(AS)

G0492.def:
**ἀντι-παρ-έρχομαι **
[in LXX: [[Wis.16.10|Wis.16:10]] * ;]
**to pass by opposite to**: [[Luk.10.31-32|Luk.10:31-32]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0461.def:
**ἀν-ορθόω**, -ῶ
(ἀνά, ὀρθόω, to set straight, set up), [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן hi. ;]
**to set upright or straight again, restore**: of persons, [[Luk.13.13|Luk.13:13]], [[Heb.12.12|Heb.12:12]]; of things, σκηνήν, [[Act.15.16|Act.15:16]] (MM, _VGT_, see word; Cremer, 807).†
(AS)

G0480.def:
**ἀντί-κειμαι **
[in LXX for אָיַב, צוּר, שָׂטַן, etc. ;]
1. to lie opposite to.
2. **to oppose, withstand, resist**: with dative, [[Luk.13.17; 21.15|Luk.13:17 21:15]], [[Gal.5.17|Gal.5:17]], [[1Ti.1.10|1Ti.1:10]]; as participial subst. (ὁ) ἀντικείμενος, [[1Co.16.9|1Co.16:9]], [[Php.1.28|Php.1:28]], [[2Th.2.4|2Th.2:4]], [[1Ti.5.14|1Ti.5:14]] (Cremer, 746).†
(AS)

G0470.def:
**ἀντ-απο-κρίνομαι**
(ἀντί, ἀποκρίνω), [in LXX: [[Jdg.5.29|Jdg.5:29]], [[Job.16.9|Job.16:9]] (8) [[Job.32.12|Job.32:12]] (עָנָה)* ;]
**to answer again, reply against**: before πρός, with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.14.6|Luk.14:6]] with dative of person(s), [[Rom.9.20|Rom.9:20]]†
(AS)

G0468.def:
**ἀντ-από-δομα**, -τος, τό
(ἀνταποδίδωμι) [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל ;] ( = cl. -δοσις, which see)
**requital**;
(a) **in favourable sense**: [[Luk.14.12|Luk.14:12]]
(b) **in unfavourable sense**: [[Rom.11.9|Rom.11:9]]†
(AS)

G0471.def:
**ἀντ-εῖπον**
(άντί, εἶτον), [in LXX for H7725 hi., דָבַר pi., עָנָה, etc. ;]
2 2 aor., without present in use, **to speak against, gainsay**: [[Luk.21.15|Luk.21:15]], [[Act.4.14|Act.4:14]].†
(AS)

G0459.def:
**ἄ-νομος**, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νόμος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
1. **lawless, wicked**: [[Mrk.15.28|Mrk.15:28]], [[Luk.22.37|Luk.22:37]], [[Act.2.23|Act.2:23]], [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]], [[2Pe.2.8|2Pe.2:8]]; ὁ ἄ., [[2Th.2.8|2Th.2:8]] (= ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, [[2Th.2.3|2Th.2:3]]).
2. **without law** (= οἱ μὴ ὑπὸ νόμον, [[Rom.2.14|Rom.2:14]]): [[1Co.9.21|1Co.9:21]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).
† _SYN._: see: ἄθεσμος (AS)

G0474.def:
**ἀντι-βάλλω **
[in LXX: [[2Ma.11.13|2Ma.11:13]] * ;]
**to throw in turn, exchange**: metaphorically, λόγους (cf. Lat. conferre sermons; see Field, _Notes_, 81), [[Luk.24.17|Luk.24:17]]†
(AS)

G0453.def:
**ἀ-νόητος**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., νοητός; νοέω), [in LXX: [[Pro.17.28|Pro.17:28]] (אֱוִיל), [[Sir.42.8|Sir.42:8]], al. ;]
1. not thought on, not understood (Hom., Plat.).
2. **not understanding, foolish **(Hdt., al., LXX): [[Luk.24.25|Luk.24:25]], [[Rom.1.14|Rom.1:14]], [[Gal.3.1|Gal.3:1]], 3, [[1Ti.6.9|1Ti.6:9]], [[Tit.3.3|Tit.3:3]] (Cremer, 438, 790; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
_SYN._: ἀσύνετος (see Tr., _Syn._, § LXXv) (AS)

G0424.def:
**ἀν-έρχομαι **
[in LXX: [[1Ki.13.12|3Ki.13:12]] (הָלַךְ)* ;]
**to go up**: [[Jhn.6.3|Jhn.6:3]], [[Gal.1.17-18|Gal.1:17-18]] (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0443.def:
**ἀνθρωποκτόνος**, -ον
(κτείνω, to kill)
**a murderer, manslayer **(Eur.; see MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Jhn.8.44|Jhn.8:44]], [[1Jn.3.16|1Jn.3:16]].†
_SYN._: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (see Tr., Syn, § 83) (AS)

G0439.def:
**ἀνθρακιά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: [[Sir.11.32|Sir.11:32]], [[4Ma.9.20|4Ma.9:20]] * ;]
**a heap of burning coals**: [[Jhn.18.18; 21.9|Jhn.18:18 21:9]].†
(AS)

G0491.def:
**Ἀντιοχεύς**, -έως, ὁ
**a citizen of Antioch, an Antiochian**: [[Act.6.5|Act.6:5]]†
(AS)

G0496.def:
**ἀντι-πίπτω **
[in LXX: [[Exo.26.5|Exo.26:5]] (קָבַל), [[Exo.26.17|Exo.26:17]] (שׁוּב), [[Num.27.14|Num.27:14]] (מְרִיבָה) [[Job.23.13|Job.23:13]] (שָׁלַב hi.) * ;]
1. to fall against or upon (Arist., Polyb.).
2. **to strive against, resist **(Arist.): with dative, [[Act.7.51|Act.7:51]]
(AS)

G0446.def:
**ἀνθύπατος -ου**, ὁ
(ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος),
**supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province **(cf. ἡγεμών, and see MM, _VGT_, 44): [[Act.13.7-8, 12; 18.12; 19.38|Act.13:7-8, 12 18:12 19:38]].†
(AS)

G0456.def:
**ἀν-οικο-δομέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּנָה, גָּדַר ;]
to build. again, **rebuild **(MM, _VGT_, see word): [[Act.15.16|Act.15:16]]†
(AS)

G0447.def:
**ἀν-ίημι**
(ἀνά, ἵημι), [in LXX for רָפָה, נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
1. to send up, produce, to send back.
2. **to let go, leave without support**: [[Heb.13.5|Heb.13:5]] (cf. [[Deu.31.6|Deu.31:6]] Hom., Iliad., ii, 71).
3. **to relax, loosen **(see Field, _Notes_, 124 f.): [[Act.16.26; 27.40|Act.16:26 27:40]]; hence, metaphorically, **to give up, desist from**: [[Eph.6.9|Eph.6:9]]†
(AS)

G0442.def:
**ἀνθρώπινος**, -η, ον
(ἄνθρωπος), [in LXX for אָדָם, אֱנוֹשׁ ;]
**human, belonging to man**: χεῖρες, [[Act.17.25|Act.17:25]] σοφία, [[1Co.2.13|1Co.2:13]] φύσις, [[Jas.3.7|Jas.3:7]] κτίσις, [[1Pe.2.13|1Pe.2:13]] (MM, _VGT_, see word); ἀ. ἡμέρα, opposite to ἡ ἡμ. ([[1Co.3.13|1Co.3:13]], God's Judgment-Day), human judgment, [[1Co.4.3|1Co.4:3]] (see Lft., _Notes_, 198); πειρασμὸς ἀ., temptation such as man can bear (AV, such as is common to man, see Field, _Notes_, 175), [[1Co.10.13|1Co.10:13]] ἀνθρώπινον λέγω, I speak in human fashion, with words not properly weighed, [[Rom.6.19|Rom.6:19]] (see Field, _Notes_, 156).†
(AS)

G0498.def:
**ἀντι-τάσσω (Att...**, -ττω)
[in LXX for לוּץ hi., נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
**to range on battle against**; mid., **to set oneself against, resist**: absol., [[Act.18.6|Act.18:6]] with dative, [[Rom.13.2|Rom.13:2]], [[Jas.4.6; 5.6|Jas.4:6 5:6]], [[1Pe.5.5|1Pe.5:5]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0481.def:
**ἄντικρυς**
(Tr. -ύς, Rec. ἀντικρύ), adv. (ἀντί) [in LXX: [[Neh.12.8|Neh.12:8]] (נֶגֶד), [[3Ma.5.16|3Ma.5:16]] * ;]
in cl., outright; in κοινή (= cl. καταντικρύ), **over against**: [[Act.20.15|Act.20:15]] (see Bl., § 5, 4; 40, 7; Rutherford, _NPhr._, 500 f.; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0426.def:
**ἀν-ετάζω**
(ἀνά, ἐτάζω, to examine; see MM, _VGT_, see word), [in LXX: [[Jdg.6.29|Jdg.6:29]] (דָּרַשׁ), [[Est.2.23|Est.2:23]] (בָּקַשׁ), Da TH [[Sus.1.14|Su 1:14]] * ;]
**to examine judicially**: [[Act.22.24, 29|Act.22:24, 29]]..†
(AS)

G0494.def:
**Ἀντιπατρίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
Antipatris, bet. Joppa and Caesarea: [[Act.23.31|Act.23:31]]†
(AS)

G0425.def:
**ἄνεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνίημι), [in LXX: [[2Es.4.22|2Es.4.22]] (שָׁלוּ), [[2Ch.23.15|2Ch.23:15]], I [[Est.4.62|Est.4:62]], [[Wis.13.13|Wis.13:13]], [[Sir.15.20; 26.10|Sir.15:20 26:10]] * ;]
**a loosening, relaxation**: [[Act.24.23|Act.24:23]] (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, _VGT_, see word); by St. Paul, opposite to θλίψις, **expressed or understood, relief**: [[2Co.2.12; 7.5; 8.13|2Co.2:12 7:5 8:13]], [[2Th.1.7|2Th.1:7]].†
_SYN._: ἀνάπαυσις (which see).† (AS)

G0428.def:
**ἀν-εύ-θετος**, -ον
(see MM, _VGT_, see word)
**not well placed, not fit**: [[Act.27.12|Act.27:12]]†
(AS)

G0489.def:
**ἀντιμισθία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀντίμισθος, for a reward)
**a reward, requital**: in good sense, [[2Co.6.13|2Co.6:13]] in bad sense, [[Rom.1.27|Rom.1:27]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0463.def:
**ἀνοχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνέχω, -ομαι), [in LXX: [[1Ma.12.25|1Ma.12:25]] (RV, respite)* ;]
1. in cl., a holding back, delaying (MM, _VGT_, see word).
2. **forbearance, delay of punishment**: [[Rom.2.4; 3.26|Rom.2:4 3:26]].†
_SYN._: μακροθυμία, ὑπομονή. ἀ., forbearance, is the result and expression of μ., which involves the idea of tolerance, long-suffering, as God with sinners. ὑ. expresses patience with respect to things, as μ. with persons; it is active as well as passive, denotes not merely endurance but perseverance (see Tr., _Syn._, § liii; Lft., _Notes_, 259, 273; _DB_, ii, 47). (AS)

G0460.def:
**ἀνόμως**,
_ adv._ [in LXX: 2Mac 817* ;]
1. lawlessly (2Mac, l.with).
2. **= χωρὶς νόμου, without law**: [[Rom.2.12|Rom.2:12]]†
(AS)

G0421.def:
**ἀνεξιχνίαστος**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; ἴχνος) [in LXX: [[Job.5.9; 9.10; 34.24|Job.5:9 9:10 34:24]] (חֵקֶר אַיִן)* ;]
**that cannot be traced out**: [[Rom.11.33|Rom.11:33]], [[Eph.3.8|Eph.3:8]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0440.def:
**ἄνθραξ**, -ακος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for גֶּחֶל ;]
**coal, charcoal**: . ἄ. πυρός, a burning coal, [[Rom.12.20|Rom.12:20]]†
(AS)

G0410.def:
**ἀν-έγκλητος**, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), [in LXX: [[3Ma.5.31|3Ma.5:31]] * ;]
**not to be called to account, unreprovable**: [[1Co.1.8|1Co.1:8]], [[Col.1.22|Col.1:22]], [[1Ti.3.10|1Ti.3:10]], [[Tit.1.6-7|Tit.1:6-7]].†
_SYN._: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (see Tr., _Syn._, § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, _VGT_, see word) (AS)

G0484.def:
**ἀντί-λημψις ** (Rec. -ληψις; see MM, _VGT_ see word; M, _Pr._, 56), -εως, ἡ
(ἀντιλαμβάνομαι) [in LXX for עֹז, זְרוֹעַ, etc., frequently in [[Psa.2.1-12|Psa.2:1-12]],3Mac.; frequently also in π. in petitions to the Ptolemies in sense of βοήθεια (see Deiss., _LAE_, 107; BS, 92, 223) ;]
1. cl. a laying hold of, an exchange.
2. Hellenistic (LXX, π.) help: pl. of ministrations of deacons; [[1Co.12.28|1Co.12:28]] (_DB_, ii, 347 f.; Cremer, 386).†
(AS)

G0407.def:
**ἀνδρίζω **
[in LXX for חָזַק אָמַץ ([[Jos.1.6|Jos.1:6]] ff., [[1Ch.22.19|1Ch.22:19]], al.; in [[2Ki.10.12|2Ki.10:12]], [[Psa.27.14; 31.24|Psa.27:14 31:24]] combined with κρατιοῦσθαι, as in 1Co, l.with) ;]
to make a man of. Mid., **to play the man **(cf. MM, _VGT_, see word): [[1Co.16.13|1Co.16:13]]†
(AS)

G0433.def:
**ἀν-ήκω**
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: [[Jos.23.14|Jos.23:14]] (בּוֹא), [[1Sa.27.8|1Ki.27:8]], Sir. prol.10, 1, 2 Mac6* ;]
prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, **it is befitting**: in ethical sense (MM, _VGT_, see word), [[Eph.5.4|Eph.5:4]], [[Col.3.18|Col.3:18]]; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.†
(AS)

G0441.def:
**ἀνθρωπ-άρεσκος**, -ον
(ἄνθρωπος, ἄρεσκος, pleasing), [in LXX: [[Psa.53.5|Psa.53:5]] * ;]
**studying to please men**: [[Eph.6.6|Eph.6:6]], [[Col.3.22|Col.3:22]] (Cremer, 642; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0457.def:
**ἄνοιξις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνοίγω),
**an opening **(in M_Gr._, springtime): ἐν ἀ., as often as I open, [[Eph.6.19|Eph.6:19]]†
(AS)

G0466.def:
**ἀντ-ανα-πληρόω**, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ἀναπληρόω),
**to fill up in turn**: [[Col.1.24|Col.1:24]] (see Lft., in l; MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0469.def:
**ἀντ-από-δοσις**, -εως, ἡ
(see supr.), [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל, שִׁלּוּם ;]
**recompense**: [[Col.3.24|Col.3:24]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0431.def:
**ἀνεψιός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: [[Num.36.11|Num.36:11]] ( בֵּן דּוֹד), [[Tob.7.2; 9.6|Tob.7:2 9:6]] א * ;]
**a cousin**: [[Col.4.10|Col.4:10]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0409.def:
**ἀνδρο-φόνος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: [[2Ma.9.28|2Ma.9:28]] * ;]
**a man-slayer**: [[1Ti.1.9|1Ti.1:9]] (cf. φονεύς, and see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0405.def:
**ἀνδραποδιστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀνδράποδον, a slave, captured in war)
**a slave-dealer, kidnapper**: [[1Ti.1.10|1Ti.1:10]] (see MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0487.def:
**ἀντί-λυτρον**, -ου, τό
[in Al.: [[Psa.49.9|Psa.49:9]] * ;]
**a ransom**: [[1Ti.2.6|1Ti.2:6]] (see CGT, in l; and cf. λύτρον).†
(AS)

G0423.def:
**ἀν-επί-λημπτος** (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον
(ἀ- ἐπιλαμβάνω)
**without reproach**: [[1Ti.3.2; 5.7; 6.14|1Ti.3:2 5:7 6:14]].†
_SYN._: ἀμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, _VGT_, see word). (AS)

G0404.def:
**ἀνα-ψύχω **
[in LXX for נָפַשׁ ni., חָיָה, etc. (frequently in sense of revive, refresh oneself) ;]
**to refresh**: with accusative of person(s), [[2Ti.1.16|2Ti.1:16]] (MM, _VGT_, see word; Cremer, 588).†
(AS)

G0420.def:
**ἀνεξί-κακος**, -ον
(fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός)
patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, [[Wis.2.19|Wis.2:19]] and see MM, _VGT_, see word): [[2Ti.2.24|2Ti.2:24]]†
(AS)

G0475.def:
**ἀντι-δια-τίθημι **
**in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose**: [[2Ti.2.25|2Ti.2:25]] (EV; but see Field, _Notes_, 215 f.; cf. MM, _VGT_, see word)
(AS)

G0485.def:
**ἀντιλογία**, -ας ἡ
(ἀντιλέγω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
**gain-saying, strife **(the latter sense being found in π.; see MM, _VGT_, see word; cf. Field, _Notes_, 106): [[Heb.6.16; 7.7; 12.3|Heb.6:16 7:7 12:3]], [[Jude.11|Ju 11]].†
(AS)

G0499.def:
**ἀντί-τυπος**, -ον
(see: τύπος), [in LXX: [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]] A * ;]
1. active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse.
2. Pass. struck back; metaphorically, corres­ponding to (MM, _VGT_, see word);
(a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, Like in pattern), [[Heb.9.24|Heb.9:24]]
(b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true likeness), [[1Pe.3.21|1Pe.3:21]] (Cramer, 357).†
(AS)

G0478.def:
**ἀντι-καθ-ίστημι **
[in LXX: [[Deu.31.21|Deu.31:21]] (עָנָה), [[Jos.5.7|Jos.5:7]], [[Mic.2.8|Mic.2:8]] (קוּם) * ;]
1. causal in Pres. imperfect fut. and 1 aor.; to replace, oppose.
2. Intrans. in pass. and 2 aor. act.;
(a) **to supersede**;
(b) **to resist**: [[Heb.12.4|Heb.12:4]]†
(AS)

G0464.def:
**ἀντ-αγωνίζομαι ** depon.,
[in LXX: [[4Ma.17.14|4Ma.17:14]] * ;]
**to struggle against**: before πρός, with accusative, [[Heb.12.4|Heb.12:4]]†
(AS)

G0416.def:
**ἀνεμίζω** = Attic ἀνεμόω
(ἄνεμος);
pass.,
**to be driven by the wind**: [[Jas.1.6|Jas.1:6]]†
(AS)

G0438.def:
**ἄνθος**, -εος, τό
[in LXX for צִיץ, etc. ;]
**a flower**: [[Jas.1.10-11|Jas.1:10-11]] [[1Pe.1.24|1Pe.1:24]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G0486.def: **to rail at ** or **abuse in turn **, (New Testament); Mid., with _accusative_ rei, (Lucian) (ML)

G0401.def:
**ἀνά-χυσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναχέω, to pour out),
**a pouring out, overflowing, excess**: metaphorically, [[1Pe.4.4|1Pe.4:4]] (MM, _VGT_, see word).†
(AS)

G0493.def:
**Ἀντίπας** (T, Ἀντείπας), -α (in some MSS. it appears to be indecl.; but see M, [[Pro.12.1-28;|Pro.12:1-28]] it is abbrev. from Ἀντίπατρος), ὁ,
**Antipas**: [[Rev.2.13|Rev.2:13]]†
(AS)
